title: AOF 追加：appendfsync no 耐久性
expected_output:
appendfsync no:
  内核缓冲(未主动 fsync): [('SET', 'a', 1), ('SET', 'b', 2), ('SET', 'c', 3)]
  已落盘 AOF: []
  耐久性: 依赖 OS 刷盘, 崩溃可能丢失大量数据; 性能最高
code:
def aof_no(writes, crash_after):
    buf = []
    aof = []
    for i, w in enumerate(writes):
        buf.append(w)  # 只写内核缓冲, 不主动 fsync
        if i + 1 == crash_after:
            break
    return aof, buf

writes = [("SET", "a", 1), ("SET", "b", 2), ("SET", "c", 3)]
aof, buf = aof_no(writes, crash_after=3)
print("appendfsync no:")
print("  内核缓冲(未主动 fsync):", buf)
print("  已落盘 AOF:", aof)
print("  耐久性: 依赖 OS 刷盘, 崩溃可能丢失大量数据; 性能最高")
